items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: he would show Prince your name in that paper. But they couldn't prove he was Prince.

ctx.x: Well, he was a big man in the theater business.

Yeah. He was just like you see me. He wouldn't fix himself up or nothing. That old man had a head on him. He used to work with the papers too. Had a paper I used to call Brotherhood Eye to say he put that paper out. I don't know if he did or if he didn't. But anytime your record was bad, you went somewhere and you wanted to be somebody and you wasn't, he would show Prince your name in that paper. But they couldn't prove he was Prince. 된된 Did I ever ask you what year you came to the city? No, you didn't. And if…
So you would come at your age when you came here?
